articles.title_en: Likelihood approach to dynamic panel models with interactive effects
articles.title_cn: 具有交互效应的动态面板模型的似然方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies dynamic panel models with a factor error structure that is correlated with the regressors. Both short panels (small T) and long panels (large T) are considered. A dynamic panel forms a simultaneous-equation system, and under the factor error structure, there exist constraints between the mean and the covariance matrix. We explore the constraints through a quasi-FIML (full information maximum likelihood) approach. The quasi-FIML approach does not estimate individual effects, even if they are fixed constants, thus circumventing the incidental parameters problem in the cross-sectional dimension.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有因子误差结构且与回归元相关的动态面板模型。同时考虑了短面板（小T）和长面板（大T）。动态面板构成一个联立方程系统，在因子误差结构下，均值与协方差矩阵之间存在约束。我们通过拟FIML（全信息最大似然）方法探索这些约束。拟FIML方法不估计个体效应，即使它们是固定常数，从而避免了横截面维度上的附带参数问题。

articles.title_en: Locally robust inference for non-Gaussian linear simultaneous equations models
articles.title_cn: 非高斯线性联立方程模型的局部稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: All parameters in linear simultaneous equations models can be identified (up to permutation and sign) if the underlying structural shocks are independent and at most one of them is Gaussian. Unfortunately, existing inference methods that exploit such identifying assumptions suffer from size distortions when the true distributions of the shocks are close to Gaussian. To address this weak non-Gaussian problem we develop a locally robust semi-parametric inference method which is simple to implement, improves coverage and retains good power properties. The finite sample properties of the methodology are illustrated in a large simulation study and an empirical study for the returns to schooling.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果潜在的结构性冲击是独立的且至多一个是高斯的，则线性联立方程模型中的所有参数可以被识别（直至排列和符号）。不幸的是，利用此类识别假设的现有推断方法在冲击的真实分布接近高斯时会出现规模失真。为解决这一弱非高斯问题，我们开发了一种局部稳健的半参数推断方法，该方法易于实施，提高了覆盖率并保持了良好的功效性质。该方法的有限样本性质在大规模模拟研究和关于教育回报的实证研究中得到了说明。

articles.title_en: Cross-section bootstrap for CCE regressions
articles.title_cn: CCE回归的横截面自助法
articles.abstract_en: The Common Correlated Effects (CCE) methodology is now well established for the analysis of factor-augmented panel data models. Yet, it is often neglected that the pooled variant is biased unless the cross-section dimension (N) of the dataset dominates the time series length (T). This is problematic for inference with typical macroeconomic datasets, where T is often equal or larger than N. In response, we establish in this paper the theoretical foundation of the cross-section (CS) bootstrap for inference with CCE estimators in large N and T panels with TN−1→τ<∞. This resampling scheme is often used to estimate standard errors, yet without theoretical justification, and with unused potential, as we show it also provides a solution to the bias problem. We derive conditions under which the scheme replicates the distribution of the CCE estimators, such that bias can be eliminated and asymptotically valid inference can ensue. In so doing, we also spend attention to the case where factors need not be common across the dependent and explanatory variables, or when slopes are heterogeneous. Since we find that the CS-bootstrap applies in each case, researchers can stay agnostic on these issues. Simulation experiments show that the asymptotic properties also translate well to finite samples.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共相关效应（CCE）方法现已广泛应用于因子增强面板数据模型的分析。然而，人们常常忽视，除非数据集的横截面维度（N）主导时间序列长度（T），否则合并变体是有偏的。这对于典型的宏观经济数据集进行推断是有问题的，因为在这些数据集中，T通常等于或大于N。为此，我们在本文中建立了在大N和T面板且TN−1→τ<∞的情况下，用于CCE估计量推断的横截面（CS）自助法的理论基础。这种重采样方案常用于估计标准误，但缺乏理论依据，且其潜力未被充分利用，因为我们表明它也为偏差问题提供了解决方案。我们推导了该方案复制CCE估计量分布的条件，从而可以消除偏差并进行渐近有效的推断。在此过程中，我们还关注了因子在因变量和解释变量之间不必共同，或斜率异质的情况。由于我们发现CS自助法在每种情况下都适用，研究者可以对这些问题的设定保持不可知。模拟实验表明，渐近性质也能很好地转化为有限样本表现。

articles.title_en: Bias in local projections
articles.title_cn: 局部投影中的偏差
articles.abstract_en: Local projections (LPs) are a popular tool in macroeconomic research. We show that LPs are often used with very small samples in the time dimension and, consequently, that LP point estimates can be severely biased. Under regularity conditions, we derive simple expressions to approximate this bias and propose a way to correct for bias in LPs. Using a medium-scale macroeconomic time-series model, we demonstrate that the bias in point estimates can be economically meaningful. We also show that the same small-sample bias issue can lead some autocorrelation-robust standard errors to understate sampling uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 局部投影（LPs）是宏观经济研究中的一种流行工具。我们表明，LPs常常在时间维度上使用非常小的样本，因此，LP点估计可能存在严重偏差。在正则条件下，我们推导出近似此偏差的简单表达式，并提出一种纠正LPs中偏差的方法。使用一个中等规模的宏观经济时间序列模型，我们证明了点估计中的偏差在经济上可能具有重要意义。我们还表明，同样的小样本偏差问题可能导致某些自相关稳健标准误低估抽样不确定性。

articles.title_en: Volatility of volatility and leverage effect from options
articles.title_cn: 期权的波动率的波动率与杠杆效应
articles.abstract_en: We propose model-free (nonparametric) estimators of the volatility of volatility and leverage effect using high-frequency observations of short-dated options. At each point in time, we integrate available options into estimates of the conditional characteristic function of the price increment until the options’ expiration and we use these estimates to recover spot volatility. Our volatility of volatility estimator is then formed from the sample variance and first-order autocovariance of the spot volatility increments, with the latter correcting for the bias in the former due to option observation errors. The leverage effect estimator is the sample covariance between price increments and the estimated volatility increments. The rate of convergence of the estimators depends on the diffusive innovations in the latent volatility process as well as on the observation error in the options with strikes in the vicinity of the current spot price. Feasible inference is developed in a way that does not require prior knowledge of the source of estimation error that is asymptotically dominating.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了利用短期期权的高频观测数据对波动率的波动率和杠杆效应进行无模型（非参数）估计的方法。在每个时间点，我们将可获得的期权整合到对直至期权到期日的价格增量的条件特征函数的估计中，并利用这些估计来恢复现货波动率。然后，我们的波动率的波动率估计量由现货波动率增量的样本方差和一阶自协方差构成，后者用于校正前者因期权观测误差而产生的偏差。杠杆效应估计量是价格增量与估计的波动率增量之间的样本协方差。估计量的收敛速度取决于潜在波动率过程中的扩散创新以及当前现货价格附近执行价的期权中的观测误差。可行推断的开发方式不需要事先了解渐近占主导的估计误差来源。

articles.title_en: Identification of a rational inattention discrete choice model
articles.title_cn: 理性疏忽离散选择模型的识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the non-parametric identification and estimation of an empirical rational inattention discrete choice model. Decision-makers do not observe their realized utility perfectly but can obtain a costly signal to inform them about the utility. This model nests the standard discrete choice model as a special case. We characterize the identified set of decision-makers’ prior beliefs based on cross-sectional market-level choice probabilities. We show that the standard discrete choice model is always observationally equivalent to some rational inattention discrete choice models with costly information. We then characterize the moment conditions that can be used to estimate the model parameters. When an exogenous variation of the choice set is available, we show that we can distinguish the standard discrete choice model from the rational inattention discrete choice model with costly information. We apply the model to study the Fox News effect on the 2000 U.S. presidential election. We compare the voters’ prior beliefs with and without the Fox News influence. The result shows that the presence of Fox News has heterogeneous effects for voters with different educational backgrounds.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了经验理性疏忽离散选择模型的非参数识别与估计。决策者无法完美观察其已实现效用，但可以通过获取成本信号来了解其效用。该模型将标准离散选择模型作为特例包含在内。我们基于横截面市场层面的选择概率刻画了决策者先验信念的识别集。我们表明，标准离散选择模型总是与某些具有成本信息的理性疏忽离散选择模型在观测上等价。然后，我们刻画了可用于估计模型参数的矩条件。当选择集存在外生变化时，我们表明可以区分标准离散选择模型与具有成本信息的理性疏忽离散选择模型。我们将该模型应用于研究福克斯新闻对2000年美国总统选举的影响。我们比较了有和没有福克斯新闻影响时选民的先验信念。结果表明，福克斯新闻的存在对不同教育背景的选民具有异质性影响。

articles.title_en: Time-varying multivariate causal processes
articles.title_cn: 时变多元因果过程
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider a wide class of time-varying multivariate causal processes that nests many classical and new examples as special cases. We first show the existence of a weakly dependent stationary approximation to initiate our theoretical investigation. We then consider a quasi-maximum likelihood estimation (QMLE), and provide both point-wise and uniform inferences to coefficient functions of interest. The theoretical findings are further examined through extensive simulations. Finally, we show empirical relevance of our study by evaluating both temporal and contemporaneous connectedness between the stock markets of China and U.S.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑了一类广泛的时变多元因果过程，该过程将许多经典和新颖的例子作为特例包含在内。我们首先证明了弱依赖平稳近似的存在性，以启动我们的理论研究。然后，我们考虑拟极大似然估计（QMLE），并为感兴趣的系数函数提供逐点和一致推断。理论发现通过广泛的模拟进一步检验。最后，我们通过评估中国和美国股票市场之间的时间与同期连通性，展示了我们研究的实证相关性。

articles.title_en: Panel quantile regression for extreme risk
articles.title_cn: 极端风险的面板分位数回归
articles.abstract_en: Panel quantile regression models play an essential role in finance, insurance, and risk management applications. However, a direct application of panel regression for extreme conditional quantiles may suffer from a significant estimation uncertainty due to data sparsity on the far tail. We introduce a two-stage method to predict extreme conditional quantiles over cross-sections, which uses panel quantile regression at a selected intermediate level and then extrapolates the intermediate level to an extreme level with extreme value theory. This combination of panel quantile regression at an intermediate level and extreme value theory relies on a set of second-order conditions for heteroscedastic extremes. A metric called Average Absolute Relative Error is proposed to evaluate the prediction performance of both intermediate and extreme conditional quantiles. Allowing individual fixed effects in panel quantile regressions challenges the asymptotic analysis of the two-stage method and prediction metric. We demonstrate the finite sample performance of the extreme conditional quantile prediction compared to the direct use of panel quantile regression. Finally, an application of the two-stage method to the macroeconomic and housing price data finds strong evidence of housing bubbles and common economic factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 面板分位数回归模型在金融、保险和风险管理应用中扮演着重要角色。然而，直接应用面板回归来估计极端条件分位数可能因尾部数据稀疏而遭受显著的估计不确定性。我们引入了一种两阶段方法来预测横截面上的极端条件分位数，该方法在选定的中间水平上使用面板分位数回归，然后利用极值理论将中间水平外推到极端水平。这种在中间水平上的面板分位数回归与极值理论的结合依赖于一组用于异方差极值的二阶条件。我们提出了一种称为平均绝对相对误差的度量来评估中间和极端条件分位数的预测性能。在面板分位数回归中允许个体固定效应给两阶段方法和预测度量的渐近分析带来了挑战。我们展示了极端条件分位数预测相对于直接使用面板分位数回归的有限样本性能。最后，将两阶段方法应用于宏观经济和房价数据，发现了房价泡沫和共同经济因素的强有力证据。

articles.title_en: Enhanced pricing and management of bundled insurance risks with dependence-aware prediction using pair copula construction
articles.title_cn: 基于pair copula构造的相依感知预测在捆绑保险风险定价与管理中的增强
articles.abstract_en: We propose a dependence-aware predictive modeling framework for multivariate risks stemmed from an insurance contract with bundling features — an important type of policy increasingly offered by major insurance companies. The bundling feature naturally leads to longitudinal measurements of multiple insurance risks, and correct pricing and management of such risks is of fundamental interest to financial stability of the macroeconomy. We build a novel predictive model that fully captures the dependence among the multivariate repeated risk measurements. Specifically, the longitudinal measurement of each individual risk is first modeled using pair copula construction with a D-vine structure, and the multiple D-vines are then integrated by a flexible copula. While our analysis mainly focuses on multivariate insurance risks, the proposed model indeed contributes to the broad research area of longitudinal data analysis. In particular, it provides a unified modeling framework for multivariate longitudinal data that can accommodate different scales of measurements, including continuous, discrete, and mixed observations, and thus can be potentially useful for various economic studies. A computationally efficient sequential method is proposed for model estimation and inference, and its performance is investigated both theoretically and via simulation studies. In the application, we examine multivariate bundled risks in multi-peril property insurance using proprietary data from a commercial property insurance provider. The proposed model is found to provide improved decision making for several key insurance operations. For underwriting, we show that the experience rate priced by the proposed model leads to a 9% lift in the insurer’s net revenue. For reinsurance, we show that the insurer underestimates the risk of the retained insurance portfolio by 10% when ignoring the dependence among bundled insurance risks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种相依感知的预测建模框架，用于处理具有捆绑特征的保险合同所产生的多元风险——这是大型保险公司日益提供的一种重要保单类型。捆绑特征自然导致多个保险风险的纵向测量，而对此类风险的正确定价和管理对宏观经济的金融稳定具有根本重要性。我们构建了一个新颖的预测模型，充分捕捉多元重复风险测量之间的相依性。具体而言，首先使用具有D-vine结构的pair copula构造对每个个体风险的纵向测量进行建模，然后通过灵活的copula整合多个D-vine。虽然我们的分析主要关注多元保险风险，但所提出的模型确实对纵向数据分析的广泛研究领域有所贡献。特别是，它为多元纵向数据提供了一个统一的建模框架，可以适应不同尺度的测量，包括连续、离散和混合观测，因此可能对各种经济研究有用。我们提出了一种计算高效的序贯方法用于模型估计和推断，并通过理论和模拟研究考察了其性能。在应用中，我们使用来自商业财产保险提供商的专有数据，检查了多险种财产保险中的多元捆绑风险。发现所提出的模型为几个关键保险运营提供了改进的决策。对于承保，我们表明所提出模型定价的经验费率导致保险公司净收入提升9%。对于再保险，我们表明当忽略捆绑保险风险之间的相依性时，保险公司低估了自留保险组合的风险10%。

articles.title_en: Identifying the effects of a program offer with an application to Head Start
articles.title_cn: 识别项目提供效应：以启蒙计划为例
articles.abstract_en: I propose a treatment selection model that introduces unobserved heterogeneity in both choice sets and preferences to evaluate the average effects of a program offer. I show how to exploit the model structure to define parameters capturing these effects and then computationally characterize their identified sets under instrumental variable variation in choice sets. I illustrate these tools by analyzing the effects of providing an offer to the Head Start preschool program using data from the Head Start Impact Study. I find that such a policy affects a large number of children who take up the offer, and that they subsequently have positive effects on test scores. These effects arise from children who do not have any preschool as an outside option. A cost–benefit analysis reveals that the earning benefits associated with the test score gains can be large and outweigh the net costs associated with offer take up.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提出一个处理选择模型，该模型在选择集和偏好中引入不可观测的异质性，以评估项目提供的平均效应。我展示了如何利用模型结构来定义捕捉这些效应的参数，然后在选择集的工具变量变化下计算其识别集。我通过使用启蒙影响研究的数据分析提供启蒙学前项目offer的效应来说明这些工具。我发现这样的政策影响了大量接受offer的儿童，并且他们随后在测试分数上产生了积极影响。这些效应来自那些没有学前班作为外部选择的儿童。成本效益分析显示，与测试分数提高相关的收入收益可能很大，并且超过与接受offer相关的净成本。

articles.title_en: A computational approach to identification of treatment effects for policy evaluation
articles.title_cn: 政策评估中处理效应识别的计算方法
articles.abstract_en: For counterfactual policy evaluation, it is important to ensure that treatment parameters are relevant to policies in question. This is especially challenging under unobserved heterogeneity, as is well featured in the definition of the local average treatment effect (LATE). Being intrinsically local, the LATE is known to lack external validity in counterfactual environments. This paper investigates the possibility of extrapolating local treatment effects to different counterfactual settings when instrumental variables can be only binary. We propose a novel framework to systematically calculate sharp nonparametric bounds on various policy-relevant treatment parameters that are defined as weighted averages of the marginal treatment effect (MTE). Our framework is flexible enough to fully incorporate statistical independence (rather than mean independence) of instruments and a large menu of identifying assumptions beyond the shape restrictions on the MTE that have been considered in prior studies. We apply our method to understand the effects of medical insurance policies on the use of medical services.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于反事实政策评估，确保处理参数与所考虑的政策相关至关重要。在未观测异质性下，这一挑战尤为突出，正如局部平均处理效应（LATE）的定义所充分体现的那样。LATE本质上是局部的，已知在反事实环境中缺乏外部有效性。本文研究了当工具变量只能为二元时，将局部处理效应外推到不同反事实设定的可能性。我们提出了一个新框架，系统计算各种政策相关处理参数的尖锐非参数边界，这些参数定义为边际处理效应（MTE）的加权平均值。我们的框架足够灵活，可以完全纳入工具的统计独立性（而非均值独立性）以及先前研究中考虑过的除MTE形状限制之外的大量识别假设菜单。我们应用我们的方法来理解医疗保险政策对医疗服务使用的影响。

articles.title_en: The variance of regression coefficients when the population is finite
articles.title_cn: 总体有限时回归系数的方差
articles.abstract_en: Recent work has returned attention to the role of finite-population corrections in empirical settings. It is well established that if the only source of variation arises from the sampling design, then the asymptotic variance of regression estimators must include the proportion of the finite population that is sampled. If there is, in addition, a random shock to each element of the finite population, then it is commonly observed that the resulting super-population renders the finite-population correction moot. We explore this setting and find that this common observation does not fully capture the richness of the result. The fraction of the finite population that is sampled defines bounds on the variance of regression estimators. Ignoring the finite-population correction yields the upper bound, which can be quite conservative.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究重新关注了有限总体修正经验设置中的作用。已充分确立的是，如果变异的唯一来源是抽样设计，那么回归估计量的渐近方差必须包括有限总体中被抽样的比例。此外，如果有限总体的每个元素还受到随机冲击，那么通常观察到由此产生的超总体使得有限总体修正变得无关紧要。我们探讨了这一设置，并发现这一常见观察并未完全捕捉到结果的丰富性。有限总体中被抽样的比例定义了回归估计量方差的界限。忽略有限总体修正得到的是上界，该上界可能相当保守。

articles.title_en: Inference for low-rank completion without sample splitting with application to treatment effect estimation
articles.title_cn: 低秩补全的推断理论：无需样本分割及其在治疗效果估计中的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the inferential theory for estimating low-rank matrices. It also provides an inference method for the average treatment effect as an application. We show that the least square estimation of eigenvectors following the nuclear norm penalization attains the asymptotic normality. The key contribution of our method is that it does not require sample splitting. In addition, this paper allows dependent observation patterns and heterogeneous observation probabilities. Empirically, we apply the proposed procedure to estimating the impact of the presidential vote on allocating the U.S. federal budget to the states.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了低秩矩阵估计的推断理论，并作为应用提供了平均治疗效果的一种推断方法。我们证明，在核范数惩罚之后，特征向量的最小二乘估计达到了渐近正态性。我们方法的关键贡献在于它不需要样本分割。此外，本文允许依赖的观测模式和异质的观测概率。在实证上，我们将所提出的程序应用于估计总统投票对美国联邦预算分配给各州的影响。

articles.title_en: Confidence intervals of treatment effects in panel data models with interactive fixed effects
articles.title_cn: 具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型中处理效应的置信区间
articles.abstract_en: We augment the factor-based estimation of treatment effects proposed by Bai and Ng (2021) with easy-to-implement and nonparametric confidence intervals of treatment effects on every treated unit at every post-treatment time. The construction of confidence intervals entails a residual-based bootstrap resampling procedure. This method does not rely on any parametric assumption on the distribution of idiosyncratic errors and it is robust to weak cross-sectional and time-series dependence among idiosyncratic errors. We prove the asymptotic validity of the proposed confidence intervals as the numbers of control units and pre-treatment times go to infinity. We also extend this method to cases where the common factors and covariates (if any) are unit root processes. Monte Carlo experiments show that the proposed confidence intervals are well-behaved in finite samples and outperform confidence intervals based on normal quantiles. Empirical applications with two classical datasets add informative confidence intervals to existing point estimates of treatment effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们扩展了Bai和Ng（2021）提出的基于因子的处理效应估计方法，为每个处理后时期每个受处理单位的处理效应提供了易于实现且非参数的置信区间。置信区间的构建涉及基于残差的bootstrap重抽样程序。该方法不依赖于对异质性误差分布的任何参数假设，并且对异质性误差之间的弱横截面和时间序列依赖性具有稳健性。我们证明了当控制单位数量和处理前时间趋于无穷时，所提出的置信区间具有渐近有效性。我们还将该方法扩展到共同因子和协变量（如果有）为单位根过程的情况。蒙特卡洛实验表明，所提出的置信区间在有限样本中表现良好，并且优于基于正态分位数的置信区间。使用两个经典数据集的实证应用为现有的处理效应点估计增加了信息丰富的置信区间。

articles.title_en: Panel data models with time-varying latent group structures
articles.title_cn: 具有时变潜在群组结构的面板数据模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers a linear panel model with interactive fixed effects and unobserved individual and time heterogeneities that are captured by some latent group structures and an unknown structural break, respectively. To enhance realism, the model may have different numbers of groups and/or different group memberships before and after the break. With preliminary nuclear norm regularized estimation followed by row- and column-wise linear regressions, we estimate the break point based on the idea of binary segmentation and the latent group structures together with the number of groups before and after the break by sequential testing K-means algorithm simultaneously. It is shown that the break point, the number of groups and the group memberships can each be estimated correctly with probability approaching one. Asymptotic distributions of the estimators of the slope coefficients are established. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate excellent finite sample performance for the proposed estimation algorithm. An empirical application to real house price data across 377 Metropolitan Statistical Areas in the US from 1975 to 2014 suggests the presence both of structural breaks and of changes in group membership.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个具有交互固定效应的线性面板模型，其中未观测到的个体和时间的异质性分别由一些潜在的群组结构和未知的结构突变所捕捉。为了增强现实性，该模型在突变前后可能具有不同数量的群组和/或不同的群组成员。通过初步的核范数正则化估计，随后进行行和列的线性回归，我们基于二元分割的思想估计突变点，并通过序贯检验K均值算法同时估计突变前后的潜在群组结构及群组数量。结果表明，突变点、群组数量和群组成员均能以趋近于一的概率被正确估计。建立了斜率系数估计量的渐近分布。蒙特卡洛模拟表明所提出的估计算法具有优异的有限样本性能。对1975年至2014年间美国377个大都市统计区的真实房价数据的实证应用表明，存在结构突变和群组成员的变化。

articles.title_en: Non-representative sampled networks: Estimation of network structural properties by weighting
articles.title_cn: 非代表性抽样网络：通过加权估计网络结构属性
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes statistical issues arising from non-representative samples of a network. Sampled network data could systematically bias the network properties and generate non-classical measurement error problems. Apart from the sampling rate and the elicitation procedure, the biases on network structural measures depend non-trivially on which subpopulations of nodes are missing with higher probability. We propose a methodology, adapting weighted estimators to networked contexts, which enables researchers to recover several network-level statistics and reduce the biases in the estimated network effects. The proposed weighted estimators are consistent and asymptotically normally distributed and have good performance in finite samples. Notably, our approach does not require users to assume any network formation model and is straightforward to implement.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了网络非代表性样本引发的统计问题。抽样网络数据可能系统性地偏倚网络属性，并产生非经典测量误差问题。除抽样率和诱导程序外，网络结构测度的偏倚还非平凡地依赖于哪些节点亚群以更高概率缺失。我们提出了一种方法，将加权估计器适应于网络情境，使研究者能够恢复若干网络层面统计量并减少估计网络效应中的偏倚。所提出的加权估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，且在有限样本中表现良好。值得注意的是，我们的方法不要求用户假设任何网络形成模型，且易于实施。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric estimation for high-frequency data incorporating trading information
articles.title_cn: 结合交易信息的高频数据非参数估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose nonparametric estimators for the explicative part of the noise in a model where the market microstructure noise is an unknown function of the trading information while allowing for the presence of an additional residual noise component. Our method allows for dependence in the observable trading information and accommodates the presence of infinite variation jumps in the efficient price process. We establish the convergence and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimators. We also propose a two-step Laplace estimator of integrated volatility where we replace the observed price with the estimated price by removing the explicative part of the market microstructure noise. The finite sample properties of both the nonparametric estimators and the two-step Laplace estimator are examined through Monte Carlo simulations. We find that our method is robust to misspecification of the unknown functional form given finite sample size. Furthermore, an empirical application using high-frequency data demonstrates that our method outperforms commonly employed parametric methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个模型中噪声解释部分的非参数估计量，其中市场微观结构噪声是交易信息的未知函数，同时允许存在额外的残余噪声成分。我们的方法允许可观测交易信息中的依赖性，并适应有效价格过程中无限变差跳跃的存在。我们建立了所提出估计量的收敛性和渐近正态性。我们还提出了一种两步拉普拉斯积分波动率估计量，其中通过去除市场微观结构噪声的解释部分，用估计价格替换观测价格。通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验了非参数估计量和两步拉普拉斯估计量的有限样本性质。我们发现，在有限样本量下，我们的方法对未知函数形式的错误设定具有稳健性。此外，使用高频数据的实证应用表明，我们的方法优于常用的参数方法。

articles.title_en: Finite underidentification
articles.title_cn: 有限欠识别
articles.abstract_en: I adapt the Generalised Method of Moments to deal with nonlinear models in which a finite number of isolated parameter values satisfy the moment conditions. I also study the closely related class of first-order underidentified models, whose expected Jacobian is rank deficient but not necessarily zero. In both cases, my proposed procedures exploit the underidentification structure to yield parameter estimators and underidentification tests within a standard asymptotically normal GMM framework. I study nonlinear models with and without separation of data and parameters. I also illustrate my proposed inference procedures with applications to production function estimation and dynamic panel data models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我将广义矩方法加以调整，以处理非线性模型中有限个孤立参数值满足矩条件的情形。我还研究了与之密切相关的一阶欠识别模型类别，其期望雅可比矩阵秩不足但不一定为零。在这两种情况下，我提出的程序利用欠识别结构，在标准渐近正态GMM框架内得到参数估计量和欠识别检验。我研究了数据与参数分离和不分离的非线性模型。我还用生产函数估计和动态面板数据模型的应用来说明我提出的推断程序。

articles.title_en: Time-varying forecast combination for factor-augmented regressions with smooth structural changes
articles.title_cn: 具有平滑结构变化的因子增强回归的时变预测组合
articles.abstract_en: This study proposes a time-varying forecast combination for factor-augmented (TVFCFA) regressions with smooth structural changes. First, we establish the limiting distribution of the estimators of the time-varying factor-augmented regressions. To estimate the optimal time-varying combination weights, we propose a local leave-l-out cross-validation (LLOCV) criterion that is asymptotically unbiased for the local mean squared forecast error (LMSFE). The TVFCFA method was shown to be asymptotically optimal in the sense that its LMSFE attains the infeasible lower bound. We establish the convergence rate of the selected weights and demonstrate that the TVFCFA method automatically assigns all weights to correctly specified models. Because the overfitted models have nonzero weights, the TVFCFA estimator asymptotically follows a nonstandard distribution. To obtain an asymptotic normal distribution, we propose a penalized LLOCV criterion such that the weights for the overfitted models asymptotically converge to zero. The TVFCFA estimator, with weights that minimize the penalized LLOCV, asymptotically follows a normal distribution, and the convergence rate of the weights assigned to the overfitted models is inversely proportional to the penalized factor. A Monte Carlo simulation shows that the TVFCFA method outperforms competing model averaging and selection methods that are popular in the literature. Moreover, an empirical application of the TVFCFA method to inflation forecasts demonstrates its superiority.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种针对具有平滑结构变化的因子增强（TVFCFA）回归的时变预测组合。首先，我们建立了时变因子增强回归估计量的极限分布。为了估计最优时变组合权重，我们提出了一种局部留一交叉验证（LLOCV）准则，该准则对局部均方预测误差（LMSFE）渐近无偏。TVFCFA方法在LMSFE达到不可行下界的意义上被证明是渐近最优的。我们建立了所选权重的收敛速度，并证明TVFCFA方法自动将所有权重分配给正确设定的模型。由于过拟合模型具有非零权重，TVFCFA估计量渐近遵循非标准分布。为了获得渐近正态分布，我们提出了一种惩罚LLOCV准则，使得过拟合模型的权重渐近收敛到零。使用最小化惩罚LLOCV的权重的TVFCFA估计量渐近遵循正态分布，分配给过拟合模型的权重的收敛速度与惩罚因子成反比。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，TVFCFA方法优于文献中流行的竞争模型平均和选择方法。此外，将TVFCFA方法应用于通胀预测的实证应用证明了其优越性。

articles.title_en: High frequency principal component analysis based on correlation matrix that is robust to jumps, microstructure noise and asynchronous observation times
articles.title_cn: 基于相关矩阵的高频主成分分析：对跳跃、微观结构噪声和非同步观测时间具有稳健性
articles.abstract_en: This paper developed the high frequency estimation for the principal component analysis (PCA) based on correlation matrix. This estimation methodology is robust to jumps, microstructure noise and asynchronous observation times simultaneously, which is enabled by the newly proposed Truncated and Smoothed Two-Scales Realized Volatility (Truncated S-TSRV) estimator. The general framework of our methodology is constructed based on the estimation of realized spectral functions with respect to the spot correlation matrix. A new asymptotic representation for the element-wise estimation error of the spot correlation matrix estimate has been derived, resulting in a new bias correction term which is much more complex than that of the PCA based covariance matrix. Central limit theorem and rate of convergence have been developed for the bias-corrected estimator. The standard error estimator has also been proposed. As the empirical study of our methodology, we have constructed the first eigen-portfolio based on the eigenvector estimate corresponding to the largest eigenvalue in the spot correlation matrix. We regress the returns of first eigen-portfolio against that of the market ETF, which obtained non-significant alpha estimate and significant beta estimate which is very close to one.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于相关矩阵发展了主成分分析（PCA）的高频估计。该估计方法同时对跳跃、微观结构噪声和非同步观测时间具有稳健性，这得益于新提出的截断和平滑双尺度已实现波动率（Truncated S-TSRV）估计量。我们方法的一般框架是基于现货相关矩阵的已实现谱函数的估计构建的。我们推导了现货相关矩阵估计的逐元素估计误差的新渐近表示，从而产生了一个新的偏差校正项，该校正项比基于协方差矩阵的PCA更为复杂。我们为偏差校正后的估计量发展了中心极限定理和收敛速度。还提出了标准误估计量。作为我们方法的实证研究，我们基于现货相关矩阵中最大特征值对应的特征向量估计构建了第一特征投资组合。我们将第一特征投资组合的收益对市场ETF的收益进行回归，得到了不显著的alpha估计和非常接近一的显著beta估计。

articles.title_en: Classical p-values and the Bayesian posterior probability that the hypothesis is approximately true
articles.title_cn: 经典p值与假设近似为真的贝叶斯后验概率
articles.abstract_en: This paper relates p-values for the hypothesis that θ=c to the Bayesian posterior probability that the hypothesis is approximately true, in the sense that θ∈[c−ϵ,c+ϵ] for a selected ϵ>0. In a setup with a continuous prior for θ, the results show that a larger (respectively, smaller) p-value does not necessarily correspond to a higher (respectively, lower) probability that θ is close to c. Therefore, the results suggest caution about common ways of using p-values, specifically the use of small p-values as a key standard in empirical research.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了关于θ=c的假设的p值与贝叶斯后验概率之间的关系，其中后验概率衡量的是假设近似为真的程度，即对于选定的ϵ>0，θ∈[c−ϵ,c+ϵ]。在θ具有连续先验分布的设定下，结果表明，较大的（或较小的）p值并不必然对应较高的（或较低的）θ接近c的概率。因此，这些结果提示，在实证研究中常见的p值使用方式，特别是将小p值作为关键标准，应持谨慎态度。

articles.title_en: Robust inference on correlation under general heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 一般异质性下相关性的稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: Considerable evidence in past research shows size distortion in standard tests for zero autocorrelation or zero cross-correlation when time series are not independent identically distributed random variables, pointing to the need for more robust procedures. Recent tests for serial correlation and cross-correlation in Dalla, Giraitis, and Phillips (2022) provide a more robust approach, allowing for heteroskedasticity and dependence in uncorrelated data under restrictions that require a smooth, slowly-evolving deterministic heteroskedasticity process. The present work removes those restrictions and validates the robust testing methodology for a wider class of innovations and regression residuals allowing for heteroscedastic uncorrelated and non-stationary data settings. The updated analysis given here enables more extensive use of the methodology in practical applications. Monte Carlo experiments confirm excellent finite sample performance of the robust test procedures even for extremely complex white noise processes. The empirical examples show that use of robust testing methods can materially reduce spurious evidence of correlations found by standard testing procedures.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去研究中的大量证据表明，当时间序列不是独立同分布随机变量时，标准检验在零自相关或零互相关检验中存在规模失真，这表明需要更稳健的程序。Dalla、Giraitis和Phillips（2022）最近提出的序列相关和互相关检验提供了一种更稳健的方法，允许在非相关数据中存在异方差性和依赖性，但限制条件要求一个平滑、缓慢演变的确定性异方差过程。本研究去除了这些限制，并验证了稳健检验方法适用于更广泛的创新和回归残差类别，允许异方差非相关和非平稳数据设置。本文提供的更新分析使得该方法在实际应用中得到更广泛的使用。蒙特卡洛实验证实，即使对于极其复杂的白噪声过程，稳健检验程序也具有优异的有限样本性能。实证例子表明，使用稳健检验方法可以实质性地减少标准检验程序发现的虚假相关性证据。
